standard.note: 26 M.R.S. 664 annual CPI adjustment (up from $14.65 in 2025). 2027: $15.70 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tippedEmployeeThreshold.note: Maine defines a service employee as one who receives more than $191 a month in tips -- by far the highest tipped-employee threshold of any state.

tipped.note: Maine caps the tip credit at 50% of the minimum wage.

knownGaps: Portland and Rockland set higher local rates -- see local/ME-local-2026.json.
